sourceSentences: Riven can activate Broken Wings three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 0.3125-second static cooldown between casts. If Riven does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.
This cast cannot cross terrain.
Third Cast: Riven mimics the first cast's effects in a larger area while also knocking back enemies hit 75 units over 0.5 seconds. This cast can cross terrain.
Moving after using Broken Wings allows Riven to do other actions faster.
cooldown: 13 [Starts after first cast]

Riven's ability casts generate a stack of Charge for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times. Riven's basic attacks are empowered to each consume a stack on-hit to deal bonus physical damage
Riven dashes in the target direction, though not through terrain, while granting herself a shield for 1.5 seconds. Riven can cast any of her abilities during the dash.
Q may be cast during W or R cast times if they're used at the end or briefly after the dash.
If Riven has a basic attack buffered before the end of Blade of the Exile's cast time, the buffered basic attack will start 0.33 seconds after the end of the cast time.
The ability will cast to wherever the caster's cursor was at the start of cast time.
deals physical damage to enemies hit, increased by 0 to 200% based on target's missing health. This is capped at 200% bonus damage at 75% missing health.
some good starter ones are to start with E into an attack before using W and Q. From here, attack into Q before attacking into Q again.
And an easy all in is to E into ultimate and attack. W into an attack before using Q into an attack, Q into attack again, and then use your ultimate into Q and attack away.
Using either of your first two Q's into a wall will make Riven wedge yourself into the wall.
Q delaying is waiting for this timer to be delayed as much as possible until you engage with your third Q. By that time, your Q cool down will almost be back up
you can auto attack Q move and the Q animation, and repeat that three times.
If you flash after E, you can still double cast. When using wind slash, Riven will always use it in the direction of her cursor.
Another trick is to use E flash W into whatever you want because E flash W makes it very hard to react to your flash.
since wind slash is an execute, usually it's better to use your Q or W before it.
